_meta.title: Batch 4 — Later Evidence Files (NOT for immediate upload)
_meta.principle: Evidence files are uploaded per module, per demonstrated need — never in bulk. A trigger fires when consultants ask the corresponding question class about a specific module MORE THAN ONCE, or a named engagement activity starts (role design workshop, demo build, migration mapping).
_meta.procedure: On trigger: upload only the matching file(s) for the requested module(s), paste the description template from document_descriptions or the file's .usage.md, then re-run the nearest acceptance suite's spot checks. Max 10 files per expansion step.

use_case_groups.use_case: technical_validation (data model, migration mapping, integration field-level design)
use_case_groups.trigger: Field-level or data-mapping questions about a module recur; a migration or integration design workstream starts.
use_case_groups.warning: Highest volume category (34 files) — never upload all at once; JSON evidence dilutes narrative retrieval fastest.

use_case_groups.use_case: security_roles (role design, permissions, segregation of duties)
use_case_groups.trigger: An authorization-concept workstream starts, or permissions questions recur for a module.
use_case_groups.warning: Shipped defaults only — pair with the reminder that client security models are design work.

use_case_groups.use_case: workflow_design (process design, cutover state mapping, automation inventory)
use_case_groups.trigger: Process-design or migration state-mapping questions recur; cutover runbook preparation starts.

use_case_groups.use_case: ui_demo_preparation (exact menu paths, view types, printable reports)
use_case_groups.trigger: A demo build starts for a module and the builder asks navigation-level questions.
Recurring customization debates on a specific module (the global framework 05 is already uploaded in Batch 1).

use_case_groups.use_case: ai_governance_depth (AI existence verification and build scoping beyond Batch 3's summary+governance)
use_case_groups.trigger: AI existence disputes ('is there really a module for X?') or AI build-vs-buy scoping sessions.
use_case_groups.warning: Inventory JSON is the existence authority — upload when precision matters more than prose.

use_case_groups.use_case: methodology (playbooks — fit-gap runs, demo craft, roadmaps, discovery, positioning)
use_case_groups.trigger: Methodology questions recur (how to run fit-gap, structure a demo, build a roadmap).
use_case_groups.warning: deloitte_odoo_partner_positioning.md is internal framing — restrict audience if the platform supports it.

use_case_groups.file_pattern: modules/<module>/functional_summary.md for: base, mail, product, contacts, hr, hr_timesheet, website, point_of_sale, planning, knowledge, approvals, marketing_automation, account_accountant, account_reports, spreadsheet_edition, quality, mrp_workorder, stock_barcode
use_case_groups.trigger: The module appears in real consultant questions.
use_case_groups.note: Finance-depth pair (account_accountant + account_reports) is the most likely first trigger — upload as a pair.
